posts.title: Introduction to React
posts.content: React is a popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. In this post, we will learn the basics of React components and how to create a simple React application.

posts.title: Web Development Basics
posts.content: Web development is the process of creating websites and web applications. It includes frontend development, backend development, databases, and APIs. Learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a great starting point for beginners who want to become web developers.

posts.title: Getting Started with SvelteKit
posts.content: SvelteKit is a modern framework for building fast and interactive web applications. It provides features such as routing, server-side rendering, API endpoints, and easy project structure. SvelteKit is a great choice for developers who want to build modern websites with a simple and efficient development experience.

posts.title: Introduction to Backend Development
posts.content: Backend development focuses on the server-side part of a web application. It handles business logic, databases, authentication, APIs, and communication between the frontend and server. A well-designed backend helps applications remain secure, reliable, and easy to maintain.
